name: Wastefulness
overview: Scripture warns against wastefulness by equating slothfulness with being a great waster, highlighting the folly of spending valuable resources recklessly rather than preserving them wisely. The wise store treasures and provisions, while fools squander them, demonstrating a lack of stewardship. God’s creation includes both those who build and those who destroy, emphasizing the serious consequences of waste. Jesus’ instruction to gather leftover fragments after feeding the multitude underscores the value of not letting anything be lost, calling believers to walk wisely and steward all gifts responsibly.
